newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Soy shipping conditions at key Brazilian ports.
newsitem.headline: Soy shipping conditions at key Brazilian ports.

text.p: The Brazilian ports of Paranagua and Santos reported the following conditions for shipping soybeans and soy products:

Vessels: Elmar Kivistik loading 40,000 tonnes soybeans/meal. Chigirin loading 30,000 tonnes soybeans. Sfyra I loading 31,000 tonnes soybeans/meal. Hanei Pearl loading 32,000 soymeal. Magnum loading 55,000 tonnes soybeans. Waiting to dock, 10 vessels to load soybeans, 11 to load soymeal and two for mixed cargo (soybeans/meal).
Road: 1,098 trucks carrying soybeans arrived on April 16, 343
trucks with soymeal and 60 with vegetable oils, including

Vessels: New Harmony docked, to load 38,270 tonnes soybeans but currently paralyzed because of a strike at the port. Orleta Lwowskie waiting to dock, to load 57,855 soybeans. Stefania waiting to dock, to load 28,400 soymeal. Glory Hope waiting to dock, to load 53,000 soybeans.
Road: 321 trucks unloaded 8,447 tonnes soybeans on April 16 and seven trucks unloaded 190 tonnes soymeal.
Rail: 109 wagons unloaded 6,448 tonnes soybeans and two wagons unloaded 114 tonnes soymeal.
